finalAssistantText: {"summary":"Reviewed only the new seller onboarding preparation flow (lib/seller-onboarding.ts, app/components/SellerDomAdapterGuide.tsx, scripts/seller-onboarding-preflight.mjs) against examples/seller-dom-staging/app.mjs, examples/seller-lifecycle-staging/frontend/bridge.mjs and tests/seller-onboarding.test.ts. Two concrete defects were found. (1) The generated connector calls completeProofOperation with a sequence/action that depends on the SDK executor's ordering and has no identity binding. It reads no pending command before completing, and nothing checks that the native completion belongs to the command the executor issued. (2) In the UI, the \"Continue to connector files\" and download buttons are gated only on configurationValid, not on a preflight that was actually run for the current configuration. In both cases the source shows a real causal failure path. Everything else checked out on source review: the fixed selectors, control types and operation option values match the staging example and bridge; unsupported selector syntax fails closed; the CLI reads exactly two checked local files and makes no network calls; no runtime/authenticity or approval claims are made; no secrets are embedded. The report type keeps runtimeVerified and backendVerified hard-coded to false. Static checks cannot confirm deployed behavior, the generated connector/smoke test was not executed, and controls hidden or disabled by CSS/JS are reported as unknown.","findings":[{"severity":"P2","file":"lib/seller-onboarding.ts","line":95,"title":"Generated completeProofOperation has no identity binding to the pending command and its completion message directs sellers to call it from the click handler without reading the pending command","evidence":"Line 95: setup text at line 96, step 3, says \"Import getPendingProofCommand and completeProofOperation in native handlers. Read the pending command to associate the issued sequence/action. After the real request completes call completeProofOperation...\". The connector's completeProofOperation({requests,receipt,status,message}) (same template literal, line 95) never calls getPendingProofCommand internally and never accepts or compares a sequence/actionId. It blindly binds whatever requests/receipt it is given to entry.command.sequence/actionId. In the existing SDK usage (examples/seller-dom-staging/app.mjs lines 19, 26, 45), observe() creates the promise that executor.execute awaits, and nativeSubmit resolves it with the observer's sequence/actionId. In the generated connector, observe() (line 95) stores the promise resolve, but only completeProofOperation resolves it, with the JSON block's own sequence and actionId. Nothing checks that the native handler that calls completeProofOperation is handling the same command that observer received. The comment \"Do not call this from a click listener before the operation has completed\" is therefore the only safeguard. A seller's synchronous click listener that calls getPendingProofCommand and then completeProofOperation with the command's identity satisfies that sentence literally.","reproduction":"Source trace (not executed): the parent bridge (bridge.mjs lines 30-33) sends an execute(envelope), and the SDK executor runs beforeAction, clicks the submit element configured for the action kind and awaits observe(command). The generated beforeAction only opens ancestors of the selected form elements; it does not decide click handlers. Consider seller code like `button.addEventListener('click',()=>{const cmd=getPendingProofCommand(); nativePost(...).then(r=>completeProofOperation({requests:[r.trace],receipt:r.receipt,status:'success',message:'Saved',sequence:cmd.sequence,actionId:cmd.actionId}))})` for several independently bound buttons. If two buttons can produce completions, a completion from button B, or one resolved after the posted command changed, resolves the pending entry with B's journal but entry.command's identity. The generated code cannot tell them apart; the 8th focused test (tests/seller-onboarding.test.ts line 48) covers only one button, one click and one matching command. Unverified: the SDK's internal waiting/lock behaviour was not inspected beyond the packet.","suggestion":"Bind completion to a command explicitly in the generated connector. For example, have getPendingProofCommand return a token or the pending command identity, and make completeProofOperation require that same sequence/actionId. Throw if it does not match the current pending entry, and clear pending only on a match. In PBP-SETUP.md, replace the instruction with a copy-paste example that captures the pending identity synchronously in the handler and passes it to completeProofOperation after the native request finishes."},{"severity":"P2","file":"app/components/SellerDomAdapterGuide.tsx","line":40,"title":"Download of generated connector is allowed with a configuration-valid report but no HTML preflight, so selectors were never checked and the report has no selector checks","evidence":"Line 40 renders the four download buttons with disabled={!report?.configurationValid}. The same gate is used at line 35 for the \"Continue to connector files\" button (step 2), and on step 2, a report with configurationValid true and staticMarkupReady false is accepted. reports from checkSellerOnboarding in the html_not_supplied branch (lib/seller-onboarding.ts line 73) are {configurationValid:true, staticMarkupReady:false, checks:[configuration, markup]}. The only guard is line 41, shown when configurationValid is false: \"先到第二步检查当前配置，再下载\" (\"Check the current configuration in step 2 before downloading\"). A user who clicks \"检查配置与控件\" (\"Check configuration and controls\") at line 34 without choosing HTML, or with a file rejected on read (line 17 sets notice + report undefined), never gets a complete report. Their selectors and the result region are never verified against any markup, but the download buttons become enabled after that partial check. On step 2, line 39 says \"修改配置后需要重新预检\" (\"Recheck after configuration changes\"). Because fileGeneration is only bumped in changed(), not in readHtml (line 17 resets report), pressing the download buttons after a config change is correctly blocked by the disabled state, and the onClick catch also clears the report (the onClick handler correctly rebuilds from current config). The remaining hole is the missing HTML gate.","reproduction":"Source trace (not executed): open the guide, go to step 1, choose no file, and click \"检查配置与控件\" (\"Check configuration and controls\"). checkSellerOnboarding(config, undefined) returns configurationValid=true and staticMarkupReady=false, with checks [{configuration, ok}, {markup, 'html_not_supplied'}]. report.checks then has no per-selector entries. Line 35 shows \"继续下载接入文件\" (\"Continue to connector files\") because report.configurationValid is true, and step 2 (line 40) enables all four download buttons.
